idea.title: A visual mismatch began with the active content source
idea.summary: A gallery and Figma design showed a project-structure story, while extracted renderer slides showed a latency-alert story. Tracing the export route to the active workspace JSON explained the content mismatch; layout and color differences remained separate fidelity issues.

context.situation: The exported carousel was compared with a Figma file, gallery preview, and design direction document.
context.problem: The eight exported images did not resemble the project-structure reference.
context.investigation: Inspected the exported images, active workspace JSON, renderer loader, slide adapter, layouts, CSS, and Figma frames. The loader selects the workspace carousel, which currently contains the latency-alert story. The Figma frames use project-structure content and some distinct composition and color choices.
context.result: Reported the source-data mismatch as the primary cause and identified renderer fidelity gaps. No renderer change was made.

learning_points: Check which content source an export actually loads before debugging its styling.
Separate wrong story selection from differences in visual implementation.
Treat a gallery image, editable design, and written direction as references that may differ from one another.
story_points: The exported PNGs contained a latency-alert story.
The linked Figma file contained a project-structure story.
The export route loaded the current workspace carousel through the adapter.
possible_angles: The carousel looked wrong before CSS was involved.
Trace output back through data selection, mapping, and layout.

notes: The extracted slides were existing untracked files; their exact generation command was not established.
